This upcoming general election will be the 6th to be held on my.osolia!

A lot has changed since, but our commitment to delivering easy-to-use services and information to Osolians remains.

Since that first June 2024 election, we've launched Discord sign in, making registration as easy as just a couple of clicks; site-wide search; and dozens more information pages.

We're always looking for feedback on how we can make your experience better. Let us know here or contact an administrator: https://my.osolia.xyz/help

statuses.content:
We held an extremely productive Assembly meeting today, going through every clause in the new constitution as well as supporting documents that will be introduced alongside our new founding document.

I feel more determined than ever to get this constitution passed. It will be a transformative, positive change for Osolian democracy.

In keeping with this government's goal to do all that needs to be done, to clear long-discussed tasks from the backlog, this constitution will pave the way for further reforms.

I would like to thank @speaker for his help in scheduling and moderating the meeting. We're just getting started!

statuses.content:
The election has concluded. 4 ballots were cast on my.osolia, representing a turnout of 11.4%.

The Digital Osolia Office provides the logs of the e-voting service's automated counting in the agency's Discord channel.

account.note: The Digital Osolia Office runs the Chiefdom's online services.

statuses.content:
The election is now over and this government remains committed to delivering on its promises to the Osolian people. These next two months will bring positive, transformative change to our nation.

The results of the Assembly meeting held on the new constitution were extremely reassuring. We will work to develop a plan in cooperation with citizens and the Speaker to pass the new text.

Next, we'll be working on making progress with economic reform alongside server projects, such as the new Assembly building. We will work to improve the nether highway in order to connect Osolians quickly and easily.

We want to improve government communication and make it easier for you to find out what you want to know. Let us know how we can serve you better, either in the replies to this post or via direct messages.

Osolia, let's get it done. Together.

statuses.content:
It was an honour to serve the Osolian people as Chief for these past 2 terms. We achieved many remarkable things, including passing our new constitution.

It's now time to vote: Osolians will exercise their most fundamental right and vote for who will govern our great nation for the next 2 months.

I hope, once presented with that ballot, you will place your faith in me once more, for another term which I can assure you will be even better.

Job's not finished. Let's get it done, together.
